name: io.github.manganate006/openlmnp
title: OpenLMNP
description: Accounting MCP server for the French LMNP tax status (furnished rentals, e.g. Airbnb hosts): 45 tools to manage properties, income and expenses, compute component-based depreciation and fiscal results, and generate the official French tax return (2031/2033) and FEC accounting export.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Personal Bearer token created in your OpenLMNP account under Paramètres → API MCP
